period_rule: Acquire 2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31 as observations become available; estimation uses only executed, published observations at a recorded vintage. No future values or forecast substitution.

priority_definitions.P0: Necessary to define the treatment and defend the exchange-rate counterfactual; start first.
priority_definitions.P1: Necessary for reconciled costs, reserve benefits and the joint economic assessment; acquire alongside P0 where public.
priority_definitions.P2: Robustness or channel refinement after the essential episode records.

requirements.dataset: Executed NBG market FX purchases and sales
requirements.units: Original currency units and GEL; prices GEL per foreign currency; aggregate USD million only with conversion convention
requirements.frequency: Transaction preferred; daily gross purchases/sales minimum for daily designs; monthly public aggregates retained separately
requirements.period: 2025-01-01 to last executed/disclosed 2026 observation; target full 2026; retrieve 2020-2024 comparable history
requirements.access: PUBLIC monthly net summaries and auction results; INVESTIGATE full gross/history tables; REQUEST daily/intraday BMatch detail if not publicly obtainable
requirements.existing: Only 2023/2024 annual net benchmarks and one October 2024 executed sale; monthly panel intervention fields empty
requirements.action: Download official tables and dated result releases, preserve vintages, reconcile gross/net and instrument totals; request nonidentifying daily/execution records for missing detail
requirements.validation: Unique records; purchases minus sales equals net; monthly sums reconcile with annual narrative within stated rounding; separate trade/settlement/publication and include zero days only when confirmed

requirements.dataset: Market FX prices, volumes and order flow
variables: USD/GEL bid ask midpoint and executed trade prices
NBG participation indicator or removable NBG trades
requirements.units: GEL per USD; USD trade and order quantities; spreads in basis points
requirements.frequency: Tick or 1-5 minute around executions; daily OHLC and volume for whole episode
requirements.period: 2024-01-01 through available 2026; event windows with at least 60 pre-event business days; extend to 2020 if comparable
requirements.access: PUBLIC aggregate FX-market tables; INVESTIGATE licensed Bloomberg history and institutional access; REQUEST anonymized NBG trade/quote extracts if needed
requirements.existing: Month-end official fixes only; no intraday market quotes or order-flow dataset
requirements.action: Identify downloadable daily market turnover; verify quote coverage/license before procuring; seek pre-execution quotes and anonymized non-NBG flow
requirements.validation: Bid <= ask, timezone and holiday alignment, venue coverage, genuine quote/trade flags, no mechanical use of an intervention-inclusive fix as a pre-event price

requirements.dataset: Official bilateral and effective exchange rates
requirements.units: GEL per one foreign currency; effective-rate index with verified appreciation direction
requirements.period: 2020-01-01 through available 2026; extend pre-period to 2015 if a longer model is justified
requirements.access: PUBLIC official API and statistical tables; exact effective-index export still to retrieve
requirements.existing: 60 monthly USD/GEL observations for 2020-2024 with valid-from dates
requirements.action: Extend API at native daily frequency and fetch effective-rate metadata; retain original fixing window and actual effective date
requirements.validation: No fabricated weekend trades; unique effective dates; quote units and index direction checked; aggregate with explicit end-period/average convention

requirements.dataset: Intervention assignment, expectations and information set
variables: documented news and expected purchase quantities
requirements.units: Dated documents, native trigger units, currency amounts and timestamps
requirements.period: Rules applicable from 2020; full 2025-2026 episode plus pre-episode expectations
requirements.access: PARTIAL public descriptions; INVESTIGATE operational annexes; REQUEST retrospective rule versions and anonymized decision inputs
requirements.existing: No verified exogenous purchase instrument or documented assignment dataset
requirements.action: Establish whether purchase variation was predetermined, contingent or discretionary; audit trigger validity and manipulation; do not transfer an FX-option rule to BMatch
requirements.validation: Predates executions; distinguishes rules from realized decisions; verifies eligibility and exceptions; excludes direct effects of any proposed instrument except through purchases

requirements.dataset: Government FX and large nonmarket flows
requirements.units: Original currency and USD/GEL equivalents with conversion dates
requirements.frequency: Daily settlement preferred; monthly category totals minimum
requirements.period: 2024-01-01 through available 2026; 2020-2024 monthly comparison where available
requirements.access: PUBLIC MoF debt stocks/flows and NBG balances; REQUEST conversion channel, settlement timing and monthly bridge detail not exposed in public tables
requirements.existing: No populated monthly government FX transaction series
requirements.action: Match MoF disbursements and redemptions to NBG deposits/conversions without treating all foreign financing as market supply
requirements.validation: Avoid double counting borrowing and its later conversion; reconcile cash versus accrued interest; explicitly bridge the 2026 debt-stock definition change

requirements.dataset: Private external FX flows and contemporaneous shocks
requirements.units: USD million; volume indices and original nominal currencies where applicable
requirements.frequency: Monthly trade/transfers and banking flows; quarterly BOP/services/FDI unless higher frequency documented; dated news
requirements.period: 2020-01 through available 2026; pre-2020 extension only for a specified model
requirements.access: PUBLIC aggregated sources; INVESTIGATE daily client net FX demand; REQUEST anonymized category totals if essential
requirements.existing: 20 quarterly current-account/reserve observations; no full private-flow panel
requirements.action: Acquire native-frequency series and release vintages; separate customs trade from BOP concepts and flows from stock revaluation
requirements.validation: No monthly interpolation of quarterly flows; seasonality, revision and ownership/valuation definitions documented; identify variables that themselves respond to intervention

variables: candidate comparison-country interventions and regime changes
requirements.units: Index levels, currency rates and annualized percent
requirements.frequency: Daily and event timestamps; monthly aggregates only from aligned daily observations
requirements.period: 2020-01-01 through available 2026; 2015-2019 if needed for pre-period fit
requirements.access: PUBLIC global series; INVESTIGATE country-specific intervention coverage and donor eligibility
requirements.action: Acquire global USD/rate/risk series; justify partner-currency selection from exposure; audit any donor for interventions and common-shock mismatch
requirements.validation: US close must not precede Georgian trading information incorrectly; units and holidays aligned; no automatic exclusion restriction or unexamined synthetic control

requirements.dataset: Reserve stocks, transactions and valuation bridge
requirements.units: USD million and original currency; gold fine troy ounces where disclosed
requirements.frequency: Monthly stock/flow bridge; quarterly BOP cross-check; daily balances if supplied
requirements.period: 2024-12 opening balance through available 2026; 2020-2024 reference identities
requirements.access: PUBLIC headline/components, quarterly transactions and statements; REQUEST separated valuation and government-flow bridge if absent
requirements.existing: 60 monthly component stocks; two annual residual bridges; no complete valuation decomposition
requirements.action: Extend stocks and reserve transactions; reconcile both paths on settlement basis with a separately retained unexplained residual
requirements.validation: Change in stock equals transactions plus valuation plus other changes; gold asset reallocation is distinct from domestic FX purchases; never assign residual to intervention

requirements.units: GEL quantities and annualized percent; currency-specific required-reserve balances
requirements.frequency: Daily balances and auction/operation records; weekly where native; monthly averages
requirements.period: 2024-01-01 through available 2026, including episode opening balances
requirements.access: PUBLIC instrument descriptions and aggregate tables; INVESTIGATE full balance history; REQUEST average balances and mapping if not disclosed
requirements.existing: No complete quantity/rate panel for sterilization or foregone refinancing
requirements.action: Build a reserve-money/liquidity identity including government deposits and cash demand; distinguish extra absorption from reduced liquidity provision
requirements.validation: Gross issuance is not outstanding stock; interest accrual uses outstanding balances and day count; purchased FX is not automatically fully sterilized

requirements.dataset: Policy decisions and money/securities market prices
requirements.units: Annual percent, basis points and GEL volume
requirements.period: 2020-01-01 through available 2026; reuse already acquired policy decisions through October 2026
requirements.access: PUBLIC; precise table exports and current metadata to verify
requirements.existing: Policy decision file extends to 2026-10-21 decision/2026-10-22 effective date; TIBR panel covers 2020-2024
requirements.action: Reuse existing decision history, fetch only missing revisions/events and extend TIBR; obtain market yields with maturity and publication convention
requirements.validation: No look-ahead from decision versus enforcement; decimal/percent conversion checked; yields and actual financing costs distinguished

requirements.dataset: Reserve investment return and portfolio exposures
requirements.units: Original currency and GEL/USD income; average balances; duration in years; return percent
requirements.frequency: Monthly preferred, quarterly acceptable; annual audited reconciliation
requirements.period: 2025 and available 2026; 2024 opening exposures; preserve 2020-2024 history
requirements.access: PUBLIC annual account categories, including a listed 2025 report; REQUEST monthly/currency averages and maturity/return detail if missing
requirements.existing: 2020-2024 reserve interest and year-end FX exposures; no matched average portfolio return
requirements.action: Extract 2025 audited notes, then seek aggregated holdings/income sufficient for matched currency-duration returns; retain gold and valuation separately
requirements.validation: Interest/end-year stock is not an average yield; foreign rate proxies are labeled proxies; investment gain versus income versus translation separated

requirements.dataset: Funding costs and central-bank balance-sheet counterpart
variables: GEL and FX liabilities by instrument/holder
average refinancing assets and interest income
requirements.units: GEL/original-currency balances and accrued income/expense; annual percent
requirements.frequency: Monthly average balances/accruals, daily where available, annual audit
requirements.period: 2024-12 opening through available 2026; historical 2020-2024 categories reused
requirements.access: PUBLIC broad statements/annual notes; REQUEST detailed averages, liability rates and matched funding attribution if absent
requirements.existing: Five years of expense categories and two detailed annual balance sheets; no reserve-specific marginal cost allocation
requirements.action: Determine how purchases changed liabilities or displaced earning assets; calculate incremental funding and foregone income under the one counterfactual
requirements.validation: Do not charge all NBG expenses or all IMF charges to reserves; consolidate public-sector transfers explicitly; avoid double counting foregone refinancing and new absorption costs

variables: short-term external debt at residual maturity
requirements.units: USD million at consistent dates; original local-currency money plus conversion rate; ARA coverage percent
requirements.frequency: Annual benchmark with quarterly component vintages and monthly M2/reserves where published
requirements.period: Realized 2024 and 2025; latest observed 2026 components; remaining 2026 forecasts explicitly separate
requirements.access: PUBLIC national aggregates and IMF ARA listing; INVESTIGATE component workbook and exact adjusted metric; REQUEST missing definition/input reconciliation
requirements.existing: 2022-2023 historical IMF component estimates reconstructed; later 2024-vintage columns are projections
requirements.action: Independently source each national component, reconcile IMF vintage/definitions, document other-liability coverage and bank adjustment; do not backsolve from rounded ratios
requirements.validation: Residual maturity not original maturity; goods plus services not merchandise alone; FX conversion/stock-flow dates explicit; denominator effects separated from reserve changes

requirements.dataset: Usable reserves, drains and external liquidity risks
requirements.units: USD and original-currency amounts; maturity buckets under 1 month, 1-3 months, 3-12 months where reported
requirements.frequency: Monthly reserves template; quarterly debt/IIP/bank exposure; contractual payment schedules
requirements.period: 2024 year end through available 2026 with a 12-month forward drain schedule at each date
requirements.access: PUBLIC aggregate template and external statistics; INVESTIGATE legal availability of private buffers; REQUEST aggregate stress liquidity detail if needed
requirements.existing: Gross reserve components and accounting FX net assets; neither is usable net reserves
requirements.action: Construct available-liquidity scenarios and reconcile bank adjustments; identify whether assets can actually cover sovereign/systemic drains under stress
requirements.validation: No double subtraction of liabilities; no unqualified netting of inaccessible private assets; same claim/currency/maturity matched; disclose gold liquidation assumptions

requirements.dataset: Cangul-Abel and QIPF model replication inputs
requirements.units: Model-specific units explicitly mapped to GDP shares, USD and ARA coverage
requirements.period: Published 2026 benchmark version and its historical calibration; relevance evaluated for 2025-2026 episode
requirements.access: PUBLIC papers; INVESTIGATE supplements; REQUEST authors/IMF replication package where not found
requirements.existing: Pinned PDFs and limited algebraic/channel calculations; full optimum not replicated
requirements.action: Reproduce published baseline before altering assumptions; resolve derivative presentation, units, time horizon and overlapping benefit channels
requirements.validation: Match published outputs under original parameters; verify first-order conditions and global optimum/constraints; sensitivity and independent benchmarks; no claim that unavailable code contains an error

requirements.dataset: External financing prices and realized refinancing
requirements.units: Annual percent, basis-point spreads, USD financing quantities and fee amounts
requirements.frequency: Daily secondary market; issuance-event level; monthly/quarterly debt schedules
requirements.period: 2024-01-01 through available 2026; longer pre-period for spread calibration if required
requirements.access: PUBLIC issue/debt information; INVESTIGATE primary exchange or licensed secondary-price history; do not assume public daily coverage
requirements.existing: No validated security-level spread series or episode refinancing-cost attribution
requirements.action: Match actual borrowed/refinanced quantities and maturities; verify risk-free comparator and primary price source; isolate reserve effect from global/fiscal risks
requirements.validation: Spread change not automatically reserve-caused; lower market yield benefits only relevant financing/maturity exposures; avoid counting the same crisis-risk benefit twice

requirements.dataset: Economic exposure to the counterfactual exchange-rate path
variables: trade by currency/product and import content
external asset/liability currency positions by sector
requirements.units: Currency-specific flows/stocks; quantity/price indices; dimensionless elasticities
requirements.frequency: Monthly trade; quarterly external/sector positions; annual structural detail
requirements.period: 2024 exposure baseline and available 2025-2026 outcomes; earlier data only to estimate response parameters
requirements.access: PUBLIC aggregate trade/IIP; INVESTIGATE invoice currencies and hedges; REQUEST nonidentifying sector aggregates if decisive
requirements.existing: Historical household/credit material is out of scope and does not measure these episode exposures
requirements.action: Quantify only consequences of the same estimated exchange-rate path; prioritize large directly exposed external flows and currency mismatches
requirements.validation: Separate valuation/transfers from real welfare, price from volume response, gross trade from domestic value added; no unsupported full-economy welfare total

variables: alternative liquidity facilities and opportunity cost
requirements.units: Probabilities per specified horizon; USD/GEL real resources and GDP shares; months/years
requirements.frequency: Event, quarterly macro history and annual calibration
requirements.period: Historical calibration from 2000 where comparable; risk information available at 2025-2026 episode dates; forward horizon explicitly chosen
requirements.access: PUBLIC macro history and published model assumptions; INVESTIGATE country-specific hazard/loss evidence; REQUEST nonconfidential stress assumptions where needed
requirements.existing: No empirically validated Georgia-specific marginal crisis-prevention benefit for this episode
requirements.action: Calibrate transparent ranges and break-even probabilities using actual usable-reserve gaps and feasible alternative liquidity; label transferred cross-country parameters
requirements.validation: Common cost/benefit horizon and numeraire; state dependence; out-of-sample/stress checks; no assumption that a crisis-free realization proves benefits
